answers.brief_reasoning: Loop i from 0 to length-2, count when charAt(i)==charAt(i+1).
answers.final_answer: public static int countPairs(String s) { int count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < s.length() - 1; i++) { if (s.charAt(i) == s.charAt(i + 1)) count++; } return count; }

answers.brief_reasoning: Append char i when i==0 or it differs from char i-1; handles the empty string.
answers.final_answer: public static String squeeze(String s) { String result = ""; for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) { if (i == 0 || s.charAt(i) != s.charAt(i - 1)) result += s.charAt(i); } return result; }
